Normalized Heritage. This item preserves the original UUID for Oldenborn (Earthbound) while converting it from a lineage-species into a heritage.

“Yesod fell. The world remembered old names. You answered.”

Oldenborn (Earthbound). You are a diminished god-fragment, an ancestor-spirit, a genius loci clawing back into embodiment. Folk might call you an elf, a dwarf, a sylph, a goblin—because mortals label what scares them. But you know the truth: you are a place-soul wearing legs.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Fey).
  • Size. Medium.
  • Speed. 30 feet.
  • Ability Scores. Oldenborn does not grant fixed ability score bonuses; your background handles increases. Your lineage leans toward CON in fiction and mechanics via Tier powers.

Oldenborn Core

At character creation, you gain Old Memory, Old Flesh (Dream-Flesh, Old Paths, Veil-Sight, You Are Remembered).

Earthbound Tier Powers

You gain your Tier I power at creation, then additional Tier powers as you level (5/11/17). These are granted as features and are intentionally light on automation—BBTTCC loves table truth more than rules-lawyering.

Important: This species JSON ships with placeholder UUIDs in its ItemGrant advancements. After you import the feat JSONs, you’ll swap these to real UUIDs (or run a wiring macro). This mirrors your existing BBTTCC ancestry workflow.

advancement.hint: Gain your Earthbound Tier I power.
